text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Autumn has reached its full fruition here at Kyoto Racecourse.
The final crown of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Upon which horse girl will glory shine?!
The race is about to get underway!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Before we head into the race,
there's something I want to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You've done well up to this day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have walked this path alongside me, and
I will undoubtedly reward your efforts.
